title_en: People's Police Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is formulated in accordance with the Constitution, for the purpose of safeguarding national security and social public order, protecting the lawful rights and interests of citizens, strengthening the building of the ranks of the people's police, administering the police strictly, improving the quality of the people's police, ensuring that the people's police exercise their functions and powers according to law, and ensuring the smooth progress of reform, opening up, and the socialist modernization drive.

Article 2 The tasks of the people's police shall be to safeguard national security, maintain social public order, protect citizens' personal safety, personal freedom, and lawful property, protect public property, and prevent, stop, and punish illegal and criminal activities.
The people's police include the people's police of public security organs, state security organs, prisons, and reeducation-through-labor administration organs, as well as the judicial police of the People's Courts and the People's Procuratorates.

Article 3 The people's police must rely on the support of the people, maintain close ties with the people, listen to the people's opinions and suggestions, accept the people's supervision, safeguard the people's interests, and serve the people wholeheartedly.

Article 4 The people's police must take the Constitution and laws as the norms for their activities, be faithful to their duties, be honest and clean, be strict in discipline, obey orders, and strictly enforce the law.
Article 5 The people's police shall be protected by law when performing their duties according to law.

Article 7 The people's police of public security organs may, according to law, take administrative compulsory measures or impose administrative penalties on individuals or organizations that violate laws or regulations on public security administration or other public security administration.

Article 8 The people's police of public security organs may forcibly take away from the scene, detain according to law, or take other measures prescribed by law against persons who seriously endanger social public order or threaten public safety.

Article 10 The people's police of public security organs may use weapons in accordance with the relevant State provisions in emergency situations such as resistance to arrest, riots, prison breaks, grabbing of firearms, or other violent acts.

Article 11 For the purpose of stopping serious illegal and criminal activities, the people's police of public security organs may use police implements in accordance with the relevant State provisions.

Article 12 For the purpose of investigating criminal activities, the people's police of public security organs may, according to law, carry out detention, search, arrest, or other compulsory measures.

Article 13 The people's police of public security organs may, for urgent needs in performing their duties, after producing the relevant certificates, have priority in taking public transport, and when encountering traffic obstruction, have priority in passage.
For the needs of investigating crimes, when necessary, public security organs may, in accordance with the relevant State provisions, have priority in using the means of transport, communication tools, premises, and buildings of State organs, organizations, enterprises, institutions, or individuals, and shall promptly return them after use and pay appropriate costs; if losses are caused, compensation shall be made.

Article 14 The people's police of public security organs may take protective restraint measures against mental patients who seriously endanger public safety or the personal safety of others. If it is necessary to send them to a designated unit or place for guardianship, the matter shall be reported to the public security organ of the people's government at or above the county level for approval, and the patient's guardian shall be promptly notified.

Article 15 The public security organs of the people's governments at or above the county level may, for the purpose of preventing and stopping acts that seriously endanger social public order, restrict the passage or stay of persons and vehicles within a certain area and for a certain period of time, and may, when necessary, implement traffic control.
The people's police of public security organs may, in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph, take corresponding traffic control measures.

Article 16 For the needs of investigating crimes, the public security organs may, in accordance with the relevant State provisions and through strict approval procedures, take technical investigation measures.

Article 17 The public security organs of the people's governments at or above the county level may, with the approval of the superior public security organ and the people's government at the same level, impose on-site control over sudden incidents that seriously endanger social public order according to the circumstances.
The people's police of public security organs may, in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph, take necessary means to forcibly disperse and forcibly take away from the scene or immediately detain persons who refuse to obey.

Article 18 The people's police of State security organs, prisons, and reeducation-through-labor administration organs, and the judicial police of the People's Courts and the People's Procuratorates shall perform their functions and powers respectively in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and administrative regulations.
Article 19 The people's police, when encountering emergency situations within the scope of their duties during non-working hours, shall perform their duties.

Article 21 When the people's police encounter a situation where a citizen's personal safety or property is infringed upon or the citizen is in other danger, they shall immediately provide rescue; they shall provide assistance to citizens who request to resolve disputes; they shall promptly investigate and handle cases reported by citizens.
The people's police shall actively participate in emergency rescue and disaster relief and social welfare work.

Article 23 The people's police must wear uniforms as prescribed, wear the insignia of the people's police or hold the certificate of the people's police, and maintain a correct demeanor and dignified bearing.
Article 24 The State shall, based on the nature, tasks, and characteristics of the people's police work, prescribe the organizational structure and the sequence of positions.
Article 25 The people's police shall implement the system of police ranks according to law.
Article 27 To recruit people's police, open examinations, strict assessments, and selection of the best candidates must be carried out in accordance with State provisions.

Article 29 The State shall develop the educational cause of the people's police and carry out planned education and training for the people's police in political ideology, legal system, police professional work, and other aspects.

Article 30 The State shall, based on the nature, tasks, and characteristics of the people's police work, prescribe respectively the service years for different posts and the maximum age for holding different positions.

Article 31 Awards shall be granted to individuals or collectives of the people's police that have performed outstandingly, achieved remarkable results, or made special contributions in their work. The awards are classified as: commendation, third-class merit, second-class merit, first-class merit, and conferment of honorary titles.
For the people's police who have received awards, their police ranks may be promoted ahead of schedule in accordance with the relevant State provisions, and certain material rewards may also be given.

Article 32 The people's police must implement the decisions and orders of their superiors.
If a people's policeman believes that a decision or order is erroneous, he or she may raise opinions in accordance with the provisions, but shall not suspend or alter the implementation of the decision or order; if the opinions raised are not adopted, he or she must obey the decision or order; the consequences of implementing the decision or order shall be borne by the superior who made the decision or order.

Article 33 The people's police shall have the right to refuse to execute instructions that exceed the scope of the people's police functions and powers as prescribed by laws and regulations, and shall simultaneously report to the superior organ.

Article 34 When the people's police perform their duties according to law, citizens and organizations shall provide support and assistance. The acts of citizens and organizations in assisting the people's police in performing their duties according to law shall be protected by law. Those who have made outstanding achievements in assisting the people's police in performing their duties shall be commended and rewarded.
If citizens or organizations suffer personal injury, death, or property loss due to assisting the people's police in performing their duties, they shall be given pensions or compensation in accordance with the relevant State provisions.

Article 36 The police insignia, uniforms, and police implements of the people's police shall be uniformly manufactured under the supervision of the public security department of the State Council, and managed jointly with other relevant State organs; no other individual or organization may illegally manufacture or sell them.
The police insignia, uniforms, police implements, and certificates of the people's police are exclusively for the use of the people's police; no other individual or organization may possess or use them.
Anyone who violates the provisions of the preceding two paragraphs shall have the illegally manufactured, sold, possessed, or used police insignia, uniforms, police implements, or certificates of the people's police confiscated, and shall be detained for not more than fifteen days or given a warning by the public security organ, and may also be fined not more than five times the amount of illegal gains; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 37 The State shall guarantee the funds for the people's police. The funds for the people's police shall, in accordance with the principle of division of powers, be respectively included in the central and local financial budgets.

Article 38 The people's governments at all levels shall include the construction of infrastructure necessary for the work of the people's police, such as communication and training facilities, traffic and fire protection facilities, as well as police stations and places of supervision, in the basic construction plans and the overall urban and rural construction plans.
Article 39 The State shall strengthen the modernization of the equipment of the people's police, and endeavor to promote and apply advanced scientific and technological achievements.

Article 40 The people's police shall implement the wage system for State public servants, and shall enjoy the police rank allowance and other allowances, subsidies, as well as insurance and welfare benefits as prescribed by the State.

Article 41 If a people's policeman is disabled in the line of duty, he or she shall enjoy the same pensions and preferential treatment from the State as those enjoyed by active servicemen disabled in the line of duty.
If a people's policeman dies in the line of duty or dies of illness, his or her family members shall enjoy the same pensions and preferential treatment from the State as those enjoyed by the family members of active servicemen who died in the line of duty or died of illness.
Article 42 When performing their duties, the people's police shall, according to law, accept supervision from the People's Procuratorates and the administrative supervisory organs.

Article 43 The superior organs of the people's police shall supervise the law enforcement activities of the subordinate organs, and if they find that the handling or decisions made by the subordinate organs are erroneous, they shall revoke or alter them.

Article 44 When performing their duties, the people's police must consciously accept supervision from society and citizens. The provisions made by the people's police organs that are directly related to the public interest shall be made public.

Article 46 Citizens or organizations shall have the right to report or accuse the people's police of illegal or disciplinary acts to the people's police organs, the People's Procuratorates, or the administrative supervisory organs. The organ that accepts the report or accusation shall promptly investigate and deal with the matter, and inform the person who made the report or accusation of the result.
No person may suppress or retaliate against citizens or organizations that report or accuse according to law.

Article 47 The public security organs shall establish a supervision system to supervise the people's police of public security organs as to their implementation of laws and regulations and their observance of discipline.

Article 48 If a people's policeman commits any of the acts listed in Article 22 of this Law, he or she shall be given an administrative sanction; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.
Administrative sanctions are classified into: warning, demerit, serious demerit, demotion, dismissal from post, and discharge from public employment. For a people's policeman who receives an administrative sanction, his or her police rank may be lowered or cancelled in accordance with the relevant State provisions.
For a people's policeman who violates discipline, measures such as suspension from duty or confinement may be taken when necessary.

Article 49 If a people's policeman uses weapons or police implements in violation of the provisions and a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; if a crime is not constituted, he or she shall be given an administrative sanction according to law.

Article 50 If a people's policeman, in the performance of his or her duties, infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of a citizen or organization and causes damage, compensation shall be made in accordance with the provisions of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China and other relevant laws and regulations.
Article 51 The Chinese People's Armed Police Force shall perform the security protection tasks assigned by the State.

Article 52 This Law shall come into force as of the date of promulgation. The Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the People's Police promulgated on June 25, 1957 shall be abolished simultaneously.
